## Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia

Native C++ / SDL2 port of the J2ME game. The game data is not included.

### Installation
Copy the game's `.jar` (Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia, J2ME; an English JAR is preferred,
Russian is chosen in Options -> Language) into this folder, `ports/heroeslore`.
Optional: a General MIDI SoundFont (`.sf2`, e.g. GeneralUser GS) here for better music;
Options -> Music switches between it and the built-in synth.

Saves, settings and `heroes_lore.log` are kept in `conf/HeroesLore/HeroesLore`.

### Controls
| Button | Action |
|--|--|
| D-pad / left stick | Move |
| A | Talk / attack / confirm |
| B | Back |
| X | Skill / next page |
| Y | Shop mode, Quest tab: quests / recipes |
| L1 / R1 | Use item / next item |
| L2 / R2 | Calm / wild guardian |
| Start | Menu |
| Select | Map |
| Start + Select | Quit |

---

## Порт для PortMaster

Положите `.jar` игры (лучше английский; русский выбирается в Options -> Язык) в эту
папку `ports/heroeslore`. По желанию сюда же — SoundFont `.sf2` для музыки получше.
Сохранения и настройки — в `conf/HeroesLore/HeroesLore`.
